description: Source code for a CWMP (TR-069) server implementation using libwebsockets, handling connection requests, authentication, and server lifecycle management.

methods.name: cwmp_server_validate_uri
methods.description: Validates that the incoming request URI matches the expected CPE URL.

methods.name: cwmp_server_check_availability
methods.description: Checks if the server can accept new connection requests based on current session and connection limits.

methods.name: cwmp_server_reply_http_unauthorized
methods.description: Sends an HTTP 401 Unauthorized response with digest authentication headers.

methods.name: cwmp_server_reply_http_no_content
methods.description: Sends an HTTP 204 No Content response.

methods.name: cwmp_server_validate_authentication
methods.description: Performs digest authentication validation for incoming requests.

methods.name: cwmp_server_handle_request
methods.description: Handles incoming HTTP requests, including validation, authentication, and session initiation.

methods.name: cwmp_server_http_callback
methods.description: Main callback for handling libwebsockets HTTP events.

methods.name: cwmp_server_init_lws
methods.description: Initializes the libwebsockets context and server configuration.

methods.name: cwmp_server_start
methods.description: Starts the CWMP server, setting up the context, vhost, and listening port.

methods.name: cwmp_server_stop
methods.description: Stops the CWMP server and cleans up resources.
